title: cleanup --help
description:
add --help readme and --help user-guide (both optionally with TOC), to help with agents.

They should basically output the readme and user guide from the repo, so these files should be referenced and included.

In --help, there should also be a hint that these are relevant for users as well as agents.

Also, --help should only give basic USAGE info and there should be --help cli for FLAGS and COMMANDS.

Maybe there should also be --help examples

Find out what fits where and how this would be well-structured and make suggestions (but don't implement yet)
